description: This file contains unit tests for the Control Ipc notification mechanism related to application state changes in the Rialto project. It defines a test fixture class and multiple test cases to verify notifications for different application states and handle ID scenarios.

classes.name: ControlIpcNotifyApplicationStateTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from ControlIpcTestBase, used to test notification callbacks for application state changes via IPC.

methods.name: ControlIpcNotifyApplicationStateTest
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the IPC control, registers the client, and mocks the event thread behavior.

methods.name: ~ControlIpcNotifyApplicationStateTest
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the IPC control.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an ApplicationStateChangeEvent with specified state and control handle.
